# Card r1-c-3: Blood Hunt rage cycling

## Brainstorm half

### Identity

- Class: Warrior
- Ascendancy: Titan
- Named damage source: Blood Hunt

### Pitch

- Name: Blood Hunt rage cycling
- Why pick it: Rage builds while you fight and spends itself on bigger lunges.
- How it clears: Keep attacking to build rage, then lunge through the pack.
- Bosses: Build rage on the adds, then spend it on the boss.
- Needs: rage passives and a spear; online in act 2; no respec; cheap
- The catch: It is weak when rage is empty, at the start of every fight.
- Playstyle: melee, combo, fast

### Chain

- Damage source: Blood Hunt, reading the target's Blood Loss, carried by the spear in Weapon 1.
- Multipliers: Bloodlust, against bleeding enemies.
- Enablers: Brutality I, for the physical hit.
- Consumes or requires: Blood Loss on the target, supplied by Blood Hunt itself.

### Enabler

- Blood Hunt: arrives at level 9, by an uncut skill gem.
- Dormant until then: nothing.
